summary: Deterministic Remotion playback and export components over frozen Timeline inputs.
context_hints: Media src values must already be current-Host projections resolved from frozen Project Asset bindings.
Use resolveProjectedMediaUrl at renderer boundaries; never infer, sign, or prepend a route to an object-store key.
A missing or storage-shaped media projection renders no media element rather than an empty src or a guessed URL.
Video and audio use @remotion/media so the same composition runs in @remotion/web-renderer; map startFrom/endAt to trimBefore/trimAfter and do not reintroduce OffthreadVideo/Audio from remotion.
Track stacking is DOM paint order only: track 0 is last in the DOM. Do not reintroduce z-index or top-first mapping.
Masks use CSS clip-path for unfeathered shapes and a canvas-generated PNG alpha mask for feathering/inversion; do not reintroduce SVG data-URI masks.

key_files.src/VideoComposition.tsx: Timeline preview/export renderer consuming projected media URLs.
